codeReview.summary: Implementation meets the feature requirements: latest-run resolution is centralized and hardened to canonical timestamp run directories, symlink updates are guarded to prevent tmp-path corruption, and benchmark validators/gates now delegate to the shared resolver. Reviewed diff shows no blocking or non-blocking correctness defects.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The benchmark-worker skill scope is narrower than actual mission usage: it says to use the skill for milestone `benchmark-harness`, but this feature is in milestone `misc-ops-hardening` and still uses benchmark-worker.

Canonical latest-run invariants introduced by this feature (timestamp-only canonical dirs and distrust of non-canonical latest symlink targets) are encoded in code but not reflected in shared library guidance, which may cause re-discovery work later.

summary: Pass: the feature is complete and correct for deterministic, trustworthy `--run latest` resolution and validator/gate adoption of the hardened resolver.
